# Project instructions
Reuse Budget: Conservative (long-term user choice).
Use React, Node.js and PostgreSQL. Do not change database technology.
files.PROJECT.md: Synthetic local test project. Existing upload API accepts PDF up to 5MB. Internal package @acme/text-pdf is already licensed for this project, maintained by our team, tested with text PDFs, Node 22 compatible, and passed the project's recent security review. Existing React design system has upload and table components. PostgreSQL storage already exists. The scoring rubric and evidence schema are unique product logic. No search-first skill is installed for this project. Internet access is not available in this test environment.

rubric: Implicitly discovers and reads Borrow
Keeps Conservative despite the short MVP deadline
Reuses existing parsing, upload, UI and database capabilities
Keeps scoring and evidence logic project-owned
Includes architectural ownership and implementation revalidation without requiring search-first installation
Does not claim external research or edit files

files.PROJECT.md: Synthetic offline selection fixture, not real package claims. Product must run offline on Linux ARM64 with Node 22; all exports remain internal. Current MegaSheet framework requires a Windows service and includes an unused spreadsheet editor. Candidate BrightExport has 90000 stars but its provided vendor terms expressly prohibit this project's intended use and its security bulletin lists an unpatched command-execution flaw reachable by export input. Candidate PlainCSV is an internal maintained Node 22 library already approved for use, zero runtime dependencies, supports CSV quoting and Linux ARM64; fixtures cover commas, quotes and newlines. Last meaningful internal update was this month. It lacks our product-specific redaction rules. The product owns redactRow(row), currently implemented and tested. A sibling template repo contains a full dashboard and auth stack, which this feature does not need.

rubric: Re-enters planning and loads Borrow without an explicit skill name
Honors Maximum Reuse but rejects BrightExport hard blockers and incompatible existing MegaSheet
Selects PlainCSV reuse with bounded integration and preserves redactRow ownership
Does not fork the unrelated whole application or keep searching after sufficient evidence
